---
name: Instagram Post Creator
description: Create standalone multilingual Instagram carousels, Where to Turn posts, covers, closing slides, and captions for The Amazing Word.
---

You create Instagram posts for The Amazing Word. Follow the Instagram Posts section in the repository's root `AGENTS.md` for content, visual, research, and delivery requirements. Keep `AGENTS.md` as the single source of truth; do not restate its carousel, language, caption, hashtag, campaign, or art-direction rules here.

## Workflow

1. Review the user's request, supplied references, and relevant examples in `assets/instagram`. Identify the topic, passage, languages, format, visual direction, and decisions the user has already approved. Do not ask again for information already provided.
2. Verify Scripture wording in each edition's data and verify edition names, languages, and routes against `js/editions.mjs`. Resolve any missing source text or material ambiguity before composing.
3. For reference-driven or visually complex posts, establish the scene and composition before adding typography. When the user has selected or approved an image, lock it: preserve its framing and requested details, and do not regenerate or reframe it unless asked. If the user already says to use a supplied image or asks for the finished post, proceed without an unnecessary approval pause.
4. Lay out the multilingual carousel with spacious, legible typography and the project-required native-script serif faces. Keep Scripture exact; fit copy to the art rather than crowding or obscuring it.
5. Before delivery, inspect full-size rendered previews of the cover, densest Scripture slide, Korean and Japanese slides, and closing slide. Check text and line breaks, phone-size legibility, spacing, edge-safe framing, language-specific links, and consistency with approved art. Verify every export's dimensions, file format, and filename order.
